what: Space-Filling Sampling via the Kennard-Stone   Algorithm
title: Selection of Entries from Clusters/Groups on the basis of Genetic Distances — select.distance
text: Selects \(n\) accessions maximally uniformly   cover distance space via Kennard-Stone algorithm   (Kennard Stone 1969)  (See   kenStone). Starting pair accessions largest pairwise distance: \[\lbrace g_1, g_2 \rbrace = \underset{g,h}{\arg\max}\, d_{gh}\] subsequent accession \(g_k\) selected maximising   minimum distance already-selected set \(S\): \[g_k = \underset{g \notin S}{\arg\max} \min_{s \S} d_{gs}\] greedy procedure ensures even space coverage without relying   cluster structure.

what: Space-Filling Sampling via the DUPLEX Algorithm
title: Selection of Entries from Clusters/Groups on the basis of Genetic Distances — select.distance
text: Extends   Kennard-Stone algorithm simultaneously construct model set test   set similar distributions   (Kennard Stone 1969; Snee 1977)    (duplex). Accessions selected using Mahalanobis   distance: \[d_M(g, h) = \sqrt{(\mathbf{x}_g - \mathbf{x}_h)^\top \Sigma^{-1}   (\mathbf{x}_g - \mathbf{x}_h)}\] \(\Sigma\) covariance matrix. step, pair   maximising \(d_M\) split alternately model test sets,   ensuring sets span full feature space.

what: Space-Filling Sampling via the Honigs Algorithm
title: Selection of Entries from Clusters/Groups on the basis of Genetic Distances — select.distance
text: Selects   \(n\) accessions sequentially maximising dissimilarity   already-selected set (Honigs et al. 1985)    (honigs) step \(k\), accession \(g_k\) maximising total   distance previously selected accessions \(S\) chosen: \[g_k = \underset{g \notin S}{\arg\max} \sum_{s \S} d_{gs}\] favours accessions collectively dissimilar   current selection, producing broad coverage distance space.

title: Selection of Entries from Clusters/Groups on the basis of Genetic Distances — select.distance
text: Selects \(n\) accessions iteratively maximising   minimum distance current selected set — also known   max-min farthest-point sampling algorithm   (Gonzalez 1985; Dyer Frieze 1985; Hochbaum Shmoys 1985) . \[g_k = \underset{g \notin S}{\arg\max} \min_{s \S} d_{gs}\] equivalent Kennard-Stone without symmetric   initialisation step. provides deterministic, greedy approximation   \(k\)-centre problem: \[\min_{S \subset G,\, |S|=n} \max_{g \G} \min_{s \S} d_{gs}\]

text: Selects set \(n\) medoids jointly minimise total   distance every accession nearest medoid, via   pam. objective function minimised : \[\min_{S \subset G,\, |S|=n} \sum_{g=1}^{G} \min_{s \S} d_{gs}\] Unlike "mean.medoid", medoids co-optimised set, ensuring   collectively represent full distribution group rather   independently scoring accession.

One representative per cluster returned, ensuring broad,   partition-aware coverage.
